subfamily: tiki: the Zombie as Jeff Berry printed it (Oxford ZOMBIE pdf 2229), every part named, Don's Mix written out as grapefruit and cinnamon syrup; shaken, not blended, and poured over crushed ice (as the Codex's modern Zombie Punch, p. 127)
glass: tall Zombie glass (about 450-590 ml), filled with crushed ice
version: v1 (Tomás, round 4, 2026-10-01). Wren r3: the drink walks; grenadine kept, one plain teaspoon. Size cut by a third at Wren's ask (v0 340 ml / 62.7 ml alcohol acted out the strength legend): Berry's three rums kept in his 3:3:2 balance (45/45/30 -> 30/30/20). Parts as Berry printed them, every one; proportions mine: against his rums, more lime (22.5 at 120 ml rum -> 27.5 at 80), more Don's Mix (15 -> 22.5: 15 grapefruit + 7.5 cinnamon syrup) and more falernum (15 -> 17.5). Falernum made at home, no almond, nutmeg or ginger (veto-free). Pernod per Hester r3 (C5): the anise liqueur, six drops, strength unsourced, never absinthe. Shaken on cubes, strained over crushed ice (as the Codex's own Zombie Punch, p. 127, a modern homage); never blended.
